title: QuestProgress
description: Where the player is inside their quests: the last quest journal the player opened for each quest, in the game's own words, and a stage number per in-progress quest. Written by the plugin to quests/<rsn>.json inside the snapshot directory when a journal is captured or a stage changes; journals survive client restarts. Fields that do not apply are left out rather than written as null. Bump schemaVersion on any breaking change.

capturedAt.description: When the plugin wrote the file.

stages.description: Quest name to the quest's raw progress value, for in-progress quests whose progress variable is known (table from the Quest Helper plugin). The values are undocumented and only meaningful as a change signal: a stage that differs from a journal's stageAtCapture means the player has progressed since the journal was saved. Absent until the plugin has read quests this session.

journals.description: Quest name (RuneLite's quest name) to the journal text last seen in the quest journal interface. Only quests whose journal the player has opened are present.

capturedAt.description: When the journal text was read from the client.

stageAtCapture.description: The quest's stage value when the journal was read. Absent when the quest's progress variable is unknown.

lines.description: The journal's visual lines top to bottom, markup stripped and blank lines dropped. A sentence wrapped over several lines appears as several entries.

done.description: True when the game draws the line struck through, which marks a finished step.
